name: Grilled Paneer Grain Bowl
ingredients: ½ cup cooked brown rice or barley
½ small zucchini and ½ capsicum, sliced
Marinade: 1 tsp lemon juice, ½ tsp each chilli flakes and oregano
Mint dressing: 3 tbsp low-fat yogurt, 2 tbsp mint, lemon, salt
steps: Marinate the paneer with the lemon juice, chilli flakes, oregano and a pinch of salt for 10 minutes.
Brush the zucchini and capsicum with the oil and grill in a hot pan for 3 minutes per side; grill the paneer for 2–3 minutes per side.
Divide the rice and salad leaves between two bowls.
Top with the grilled paneer and vegetables and drizzle with the dressing.
note: A balanced plate: about a quarter protein, a quarter grain and half non-starchy vegetables.
